query:
SELECT u.id AS "id: UserId", h.handle AS "handle: Handle", u.display_name,
            u.status AS "status: AccountStatus", p.id AS "picture?: PictureId", u.created_at FROM users u
            JOIN handles h ON h.user_id = u.id AND h.released_at IS NULL
            LEFT JOIN profile_pictures p ON p.user_id = u.id AND u.status = 'active' ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC
                LIMIT $1
